_comment: HDSP Frontend service — Phase 9, Task 9.2. Built from infrastructure/docker/frontend.Dockerfile with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL baked in at image-build time per environment (staging vs. production each need their own image tag). Sized per the 'Small (pilot)' tier (2 tasks).
_service_notes: ECS service: desiredCount=2, attached to the ALB target group on port 3000 (see infrastructure/terraform/alb.tf's host-based routing rule -- the frontend is the default/catch-all target for a tenant subdomain, the API target is matched by a /api/* path rule on the same host).
